args.summary:
Modeled a three-span cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box girder bridge (30+45+30 m bearing centre-lines, deck 12.5 m wide) as a 2D spine-beam model (MR-01), system "continuous_on_piers" (MR-05) since both intermediate supports are piers with given column geometry.

Key decisions:
- Girder: single-cell cast box, A=7.05 m², I=4.7775 m⁴ (integrated section, MR-02); C55 concrete Ec=35500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); γ=26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1, prestressed); w=183.3 kN/m, m=18.685 t/m (MR-07, self-weight only).
- Bearings: Abutments 0 & 3 and Pier 2 = PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric (2 per line, longitudinally free, Kh=0, MR-03); Pier 1 = plain laminated elastomeric fixed (2 per line, longitudinal spring Kh=13091 kN/m). Shape factors S=10.10/14.69/13.54/10.10 and vertical stiffnesses Kv=3.61e6/8.97e6/8.08e6/3.61e6 kN/m computed per JTG 3362-2018 8.7 using the manufacturer's Ge=1.2 MPa.
- Piers: twin 1.4 m circular C40 columns merged to a single column (MR-06); Pier 1 A=3.079 m², I=0.3771 m⁴, L=6 m; Pier 2 same section, L=29 m; Ec=32500 MPa.
- Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes (JTG D60-2015 4.3.1), ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320/350/320 kN for spans 1/2/3.

Modal analysis gave f1=3.239 Hz, giving impact factor μ=0.192 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).

generate_model succeeded (all L1/L2/L3 checks passed). Self-weight reactions ~1811/7843/7735/1858 kN; self-weight midspan moments 6546/18945/7244 kNm and support moments -28150/-26755 kNm. Governing live-load moments: max positive 11254 kNm (midspan 2), max negative -8975 kNm (support 1).
